name: MOMENTUM_PROSPECTIVE_30D_V1
technical_rules: Unchanged7day momentum,BTC7direction,ATR/turnover/stop/24h rules. Freeze candidates,gate decisions and daily stop updates before planned01UTC entry. Missing freezes remain missing; never backfill.
paper_lane: Prospectively frozen signals, subsequently evaluated with first-observed closed H1 Last/Fair and realized historical funding. H1 open fills remain modeled, not live execution. Open positions remain open in intermediate reports.
observation_lane: Capture actual timestamped public bid/ask and top3candidate depth only during01UTC+5min. Record delays or missed observations; never reconstruct an old quote. Compare selected paper entries with observations. No actual orders or broker fill claims.
initial_balances: IndependentUS$100 for each of2risk policies and each of2cost schedules; four paper wallets, no real capital.
integrity: Pin protocol and code hashes; pin initial contract rules; retain immutable first-observed prices/funding, freeze daily events before outcomes, append hash-chained journal and reject changed historical paper trades. Changed contract rules block that symbol for new daily entries.
end_policy: Thirty decisions only. Stop opening after decision_end_exclusive; finalize after last24hposition can close. No claim of success before checkpoint; production approval alwaysfalse. If sample or source coverage inadequate, report inconclusive rather than changing rules.
publish_scope: Only the research code branch and dedicated forward-state branch; no main, scanner-state, account API, orders or Telegram.
